# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

body:
Greptile Summary

 The PR replaces whole-directory hot-cache invalidation with name-range sections that can be refreshed and reconciled independently. - Builds section boundaries during directory listing. - Invalidates sections after bursts of remote changes while excluding local writes. - Reconciles refreshed ranges through entry and section version floors. - Falls back to direct listing and cache rebuilding when a section grows beyond the refresh limit.

Confidence Score: 4/5

 The PR is not yet safe to merge because a pre-upgrade filer can leave an invalidated section permanently serving deleted directory entries. A zero-snapshot refresh marks the section unverifiable, future refresh discovery excludes it, and readdir continues enumerating the unreconciled local cache, so the previously reported stale-name failure remains. **Files Needing Attention:** weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache_sections.go, weed/mount/weedfs_dir_read.go

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache_sections.go | Introduces section state, hot-range invalidation, snapshot range listing, and version-gated reconciliation; zero-snapshot sections still have an outstanding stale-listing failure. | | weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache.go | Integrates section state and refresh requests into the serialized metadata apply loop and version-floor handling. | | weed/mount/weedfs_dir_read.go | Refreshes stale sections before reading additional cached directory pages and falls back to direct reads for oversized ranges. | | weed/mount/meta_cache/meta_cache_sections_test.go | Adds focused coverage for section boundaries, invalidation, refresh reconciliation, pagination, version floors, and zero-snapshot behavior. | | weed/command/mount.go | Raises the default maximum number of locally cached directory entries from 10,000 to 100,000. |

Flowchart

 ```mermaid %%{init: {'theme': 'neutral'}}%% flowchart TD A[Remote metadata events] --> B{Section reaches hot threshold?} B -- No --> C[Apply event to cache] B -- Yes --> D[Mark affected name range stale] D --> E[Readdir reaches stale range] E --> F[List range from filer snapshot] F --> G{Snapshot available?} G -- Yes --> H[Reconcile through version gates] H --> I[Install section floor and mark fresh] G -- No --> J[Mark section unverifiable] J --> K[Continue serving maintained local cache] ```
